reason: Hash-binding metadata is excluded from the candidate source-tree hash to prevent circular digests.
manifest_scope: all governed payload files outside the exclusions
checksum_scope: every release file except SHA256SUMS.txt itself; therefore MANIFEST.json is checksum-bound
archive_binding: The detached clean-ZIP SHA-256 binds all files including integrity metadata and SHA256SUMS.txt.
candidate_tree_mode_binding: file modes are outside the source-tree byte hash but are fixed by policy and bound by the detached ZIP SHA-256
candidate_manifest_scope: all governed payload files outside candidate-tree exclusions
release_manifest_scope: every release file except MANIFEST.json and SHA256SUMS.txt, which are explicit non-self-referential integrity roots
complete_file_binding: payload and metadata are manifest-bound; MANIFEST.json is checksum-bound; SHA256SUMS.txt and all archive attributes are detached-ZIP-hash-bound
